description: This source file implements a command-line utility for verifying and analyzing WPEFramework shared libraries and files. It includes functions for parsing command-line options, reading shared libraries, and recursively reading directories to load and print information about plugin libraries.

methods.name: ParseOptions
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to determine load locations and options, and displays help message if needed.

methods.name: ReadFile
methods.description: Loads a shared library file, retrieves module name and build reference, and prints information.

methods.name: ReadDirectory
methods.description: Recursively reads a directory, processing each file or subdirectory found.
